1aca9f8f.text:
The samophlange control console can be used to autmoatically regulate the flow of fuels, gasses, liquids, and related machinery. Once initial configuration has been completed, it should run worry free with minor maintenance.

Brief listing of control console components (from left to right)

I. Main Power Lever

The engaged position enables the samophlange. The control mechanism will not automatically disengage when the lever is put in the off position. This will merely
1aca9f8f.title: Control Console Operating Manual

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

14728|9cac81e8.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9cac81e8.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

248196|dd3ed090.name: Apothecary Durelle
248196|dd3ed090.text:
Please do not touch the vials unless you intend to purchase one.

Fingerprints ruin the value, you see.

248197|cc5aee35.name: Gor'mak
248197|cc5aee35.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

248199|4ee395b7.name: Beneris
248199|4ee395b7.text: Oh! Greetings, friend. Feel free to browse my wares.

248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3004|3236d362.name: Tepa
3004|3236d362.text: Aren't the patterns beautiful? Each one speaks with its own voice.

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

5784|3fc6ad9d.name: Waldor
5784|3fc6ad9d.text: The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $N. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

7233|0c7ac5e1.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|0c7ac5e1.text:
Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.

Just last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!

The lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.

78143-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78143-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78143-complete.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

78143-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78143-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143-progress.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
